_obs: Bloco 120: a música em camadas (Prompt 7). Todas as faixas de estação têm o MESMO BPM e o MESMO tom (para tocarem juntas, AudioStreamSynchronized). dia = melodia, noite = pad/drone, perigo = percussão. 120 s = 40 compassos de 4/4 a 80 BPM. As 4 músicas do Bloco 117 (abertura, intro, jogo, perigo) ficam no slots.json e servem de fallback. Gerar: python tools/elevenlabs/gerar_musica.py --so estacao:primavera --dry-run

faixas.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Dark folk meets industrial: steel-string acoustic guitar, accordion, metal percussion and rattling chains, low drones. Exactly 80 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor, 40 bars (120 seconds). Steady energy from the first bar to the last, no intro build and no ending, so it loops without a break. Season: SPRING, the thaw and a cautious hope after the cold: meltwater dripping, a fragile brighter feel, but still weary and worn. DAYTIME MELODY LAYER: solo steel-string acoustic guitar and accordion play the main melody over a very soft low drone; percussion is only one soft metal tap on beats 2 and 4. Nothing else.

Instrumental only, no vocals. MAIN MENU THEME of a survival game about a mining colony after a solar flare. Dark folk meets industrial: steel-string acoustic guitar melody, accordion, metal percussion and chains, low drones. Exactly 80 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor, 40 bars (120 seconds). A full arrangement with a memorable melody, solemn and hopeful, steady energy from the first bar to the last so it loops without a break.

Instrumental only, no vocals. VICTORY THEME: the colony survives and the solar shield is finished. Dark folk meets industrial but warm and triumphant though weary: accordion and steel-string guitar carrying a rising melody, resonant metal percussion, deep warm drones. Exactly 80 BPM, 4/4 time, starts in D minor and resolves to D major, 20 bars (60 seconds), a full ending on a final held chord that fades out.

Instrumental only, no vocals. DEFEAT THEME: the colony has fallen. Dark folk meets industrial, somber and hollow: a slow descending steel-string guitar line, a lonely accordion, slow funeral-march metal percussion and chains, heavy low drones. Exactly 80 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor, 20 bars (60 seconds), sparser and quieter as it goes, ending on a long fading drone.
